_comment: Copy to configuration/inventory.json (gitignored) and fill in your machines. The inventory lists hosts only — how many nodes land on them is decided per deployment by --nodes.
_placement: One Spock node per host. If --nodes exceeds the host count, surplus nodes share hosts on ports base_port+1, +2, ... A standby is placed on a host other than its leader's whenever one is free.
_keys: Never commit private keys. Prefer an ssh-agent (ssh-add your key and leave key_file empty), or set PG_CLUSTER_SSH_KEY. If you must use a file, put it in keys/ — that directory is gitignored — and chmod 600 it.
_sudo: Each username needs passwordless sudo on its host; every step runs through `sudo -n`.

hosts.name: local
hosts.description: Run everything on this machine, no SSH. Handy for a single-host test cluster.
